name: Navatejares (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally crimson over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navatejares (a chequy field above a bull on a mount).
history: Municipal flag of Navatejares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Navatejares arms — chequy above a bull
